questions.contextText:
Directions for Questions 96 to 100:
Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow:
"The rapid diffusion of artificial intelligence into societal workflows presents both transformative opportunities and
unprecedented ethical dilemmas. While automation promises substantial gains in economic productivity, it also
threatens labor dislocation and amplifies algorithmic biases. Technological determinism—the belief that technology
evolves autonomously beyond human control—must be rejected in favor of ethical stewardship. Autonomous
systems reflect the values, blind spots, and systemic biases of the datasets upon which they are trained. Ensuring
equitable outcomes therefore demands robust governance frameworks, rigorous regulatory oversight, and a
commitment to preserving human agency in critical decision-making processes."
questions.questionText: According to the passage, what dual effect does artificial intelligence present?
options: Transformative opportunities along with unprecedented ethical dilemmas
Solely positive economic yields without any societal drawbacks
The immediate elimination of all manual labor
